olivia: quick follow-up from the kernel-selection RFC — ran into a consistency gap when SM gating is enabled across A100 vs H100 vs L4. noticed ~15% higher p99 on H100 for short-sequence chat workloads with the sm-optimized attention path.
rajesh: can you paste the runs? config + perf numbers pls. :thinking:
olivia: sure. reproducer: `--model redwood-v1-7b --seq 64 --batch 4 --warm 20 --iter 200` and runtime flag `SM_GATE=1`. results from yesterday: A100 p50 12ms p99 48ms, H100 p50 10ms p99 56ms, L4 p50 14ms p99 62ms. tokens/sec roughly A100 850, H100 920, L4 630.
mina: interesting — H100 higher mean but worse tail. maybe kernel preemption or thermal throttling? did you check SM capability probe output?
olivia: attached snippet from the probe run below: ```
SM_PROBE: {
  sm_version: 89,
  warp_size_detected: 32,
  sm_features: [tensorcore_fp8, async_copy, mma_epilog],
  gating_path: selected('sm-optim')
}
```
thomas: are we sure the selected kernel is identical across devices? we have multiple variants for attention: `attn_sm_opt`, `attn_mfcc`, `attn_fallback_cuda`. maybe H100 picks `attn_sm_opt_v2` which has a different reduction schedule.
olivia: i inspected binary names — H100 used `attn_sm_opt_v2`, A100 used `attn_sm_opt_v1`. both claim correctness but micro-kernels differ.
rajesh: could be divergence in warp-level sync points causing more serialization on certain lengths. do we have perf counters (stall cycles, occupancy)?
olivia: yes — quick counters: A100 stall% 18, H100 stall% 32, L4 stall% 45. occupancy similar. so stalling looks higher on H100.
eli: FYI we also saw this pattern in canary last month for short chat workloads — we masked it by forcing `attn_sm_opt_v1` on H100 which reduced p99 by ~20% but hurt longer sequences.
qa-sim: can confirm: gating to a single variant reduced tail but increased mean for seq>1024. tests in perf harness: `seq=2048` avg latency up 12%.
mina: tradeoff then: single-variant for tail vs variant routing by sequence length. we probably need a routing policy param: `kernel_routing: { preferred: ['attn_sm_opt_v1'], policy: 'seq_based' }`.
thomas: propose adding a lightweight runtime probe that samples incoming seq lengths and attaches a hint when calling kernel selector. probe should run in background and update a small LRU on per-model basis. low risk to implement.
rajesh: agree. also add a canary flag `FORCE_KERN=attn_sm_opt_v1` for quick rollback during rollouts. infra-bot: recorded experiment 1934567000 with `FORCE_KERN` toggles.
olivia: also want to add a metric: `kernel_selection_mismatch` tagged by device, model, seq_bucket so we can alert if selection differs between identical HW/probe results.
eli: +1. would help detect nondeterministic selector heuristics.
mina: another thought — L4 struggling because of lower compute & quantized path. maybe gating should consider quant-mode: if `quant=4bit` prefer `attn_mfcc` fallback.
rajesh: yes include `quant_mode` in the capability vector. current probe doesn't include it.
olivia: I'll draft a small RFC addendum: (1) extend probe to include quant_mode and micro-arch flags, (2) introduce sequence-based routing hint and `FORCE_KERN` admin override, (3) add metric `kernel_selection_mismatch`, (4) rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automated rollback on p99 spike >10%.
thomas: timeline?
olivia: can push PR with probe + metrics this week, runtime selector change next week, canary w/ infra support after QA signoff.
eli: note: we should avoid tight coupling between probe schema and kernel implementation to prevent frequent schema bumps. version the probe payload (probe_v1, probe_v2).
mina: agreed. include `probe_schema_version` in payload.
rajesh: also add fallback policy: if a selected kernel exceeds dynamic stall threshold (e.g., stall% > 30 for 10s) auto-switch to fallback kernel for in-flight requests and mark instance as degraded. needs careful correctness testing.
olivia: good point. will include an emergency fallback policy in the RFC.
qa-sim: I'll prepare regression tests for short and long seqs and quant modes — small matrix: {seq: [64,512,2048], quant: [fp16,4bit], device: [A100,H100,L4]} and will run against PR.
olivia: thanks — I'll open PR with draft and link the perf logs. tagging @rajesh @mina for review. :rocket:
infra-bot: deployment note: created canary group `sm-gating-probe-canary` and scheduled job 1934567900 to run config sweeps.
